subject: Next steps & contract hand-off: pilot timeline and owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T10:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up from demo — data handling, decision criteria, next steps

Hi Sara — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the items we promised to follow up on: 

- Decision criteria you listed: latency at 95th pct < 300ms for summary flows, on-prem/VPC option for PHI, predictable unit cost estimates for 6–12 month pilot.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Michael Ortega (economic buyer), Procurement lead (Nina Kapoor), Legal (Thomas Reed), Security (Priya Shah). Please confirm if I captured that correctly.
- Action items for us: send NDA, draft MSA & DPA, a short mutual action plan with milestone dates, and a security evidence bundle (SOC 2 + data retention + model sandbox access).

Proposed immediate sequence: NDA -> tech pilot access -> procurement & legal redlines on MSA/DPA in parallel while tech eval runs. If procurement/legal need different ordering, we can adjust.

I can own coordination on our side; looping in Marissa for contracting and Rishi for security/compliance evidence.

Next step: I’ll send the NDA + a draft MSA for their review by EOD tomorrow unless you prefer DocuSign for NDA.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: call_recording_stub_20260630.mp4)

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@atlashealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Ortega <mortega@atlashealth.com>, Nina Kapoor <nina.kapoor@atlashealth.com>, Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@atlashealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — data handling, decision criteria, next steps

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Your stakeholder list is correct. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Michael Ortega (SVP Product) — final sign-off on budget and timeline.
- Procurement: Nina Kapoor — usual SLA/contract routing; typical procurement review is ~2–3 weeks depending on redlines.
- Legal: Thomas Reed (in-house counsel) — will own MSA and DPA redlines.
- Security: Priya Shah (Head of InfoSec) — will need SOC 2 Type II, data flow diagrams, and an environment we can test against (sandbox).

Decision criteria prioritized: 1) PHI-safe architecture & contractual DPA, 2) latency/availability guarantees, 3) predictable pricing for pilot.

Procurement asks: If you can provide an initial MSA + DPA and a short summary of what you consider non-negotiable commercial terms, that’ll help speed review. Also, we prefer NDA via DocuSign for our records.

I’ve copied the relevant stakeholders — Nina and Thomas, please let us know typical legal turn-times and any known blockers up front.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Director, Data Platforms
Atlas Health
(External)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-05T14:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: Atlas — stakeholder routing & proposed redline sequencing

Team — copying the stakeholder details from Sara above. Proposed internal owners and sequence so we move quickly without stepping on procurement/legal: 

- Initial step: Send NDA via DocuSign (Ben to send). Quick signature from Atlas (1–2 business days typical).
- Parallel: Provide security evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram) and schedule a 60-min tech sandbox session (Rishi to own).
- Commercial: Marissa to own MSA commercial terms (pricing/term); aim to produce a first-pass MSA with highlighted non-negotiables.
- Legal: After Marissa’s commercial highlights, route to Thomas Reed for legal redlines. Ask for 7–10 business day turnaround on initial legal redline; flag complex items that need escalation.
- Procurement: Nina will run procurement checklist after legal redlines; plan for 3–4 business days if no changes.

Routing notes: Thomas has historically pushed back on broad indemnities and vendor data handling clauses — recommend we prepare an alternate DPA clause set and clarify breach/notification windows up front. Also prepare a limited pilot addendum to keep scope/timeboxed while legal completes MSA.

Deliverables I’ll prepare: NDA (DocuSign), draft MSA with commercial callouts, DPA template, and a 3-step mutual action plan spreadsheet. I attached a routing matrix that maps owner -> expected turn time.

Please review owners and the proposed SLA for legal turn-times; if you see potential blockers (e.g., Thomas requires redline windows longer than 10 business days), call it out now so I can reset the plan with the customer.

Thanks,
Ben

(Attachment: Routing_Matrix_legal-procurement_20260705.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Michael Ortega <mortega@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Nina Kapoor <nina.kapoor@atlashealth.com>, Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@atlashealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T11:17:00Z
Subject: NDA + draft MSA & mutual action plan (proposed dates)

Hi all — attaching the NDA (DocuSign link below) and a draft MSA + DPA for initial review. Also attached a short mutual action plan with proposed milestone dates so Atlas can align internal calendars: 

- 7/08: NDA sent (DocuSign) — target signature 1–2 business days
- 7/12: Tech sandbox session + security Q&A (Rishi to run)
- 7/22: Pilot acceptance criteria & initial tech evaluation complete
- 7/29: Procurement & legal initial redlines returned
- 8/05: Finalize MSA/DPA and scope addendum (aim: commercial signatures)

Notes on sequencing: We recommend legal and procurement run in parallel where possible; Thomas, if you prefer a different order, we can accommodate — Marissa will track commercial items independently.

DocuSign NDA: https://www.docusign.com/na1/envelope/ABC123-Atlas-NDA
Attachments: NDA_Atlas_Redwood_20260708.pdf, Atlas_Pilot_MSA_draft_20260708.docx, Mutual_Action_Plan_20260708.xlsx

Date: 2026-07-12T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: NDA + draft MSA & mutual action plan (proposed dates)

Ben and team — thanks for the thorough plan. A few items from my side: 

1) NDA: Nina and I will sign via DocuSign today. Please ensure the NDA scope is limited to pilot data (no enterprise-wide covers).
2) Legal turnaround: We’ll ask Thomas to move quickly, but if there are high-cost indemnity items we’ll want to discuss commercial mitigations. Can you provide the specific contract language you expect to be non-negotiable?
3) Pilot workaround: To keep momentum, we’re open to a limited 30-day pilot under a temporary letter of intent with baseline privacy commitments while legal completes the MSA. Please draft a short pilot addendum we can accept quickly.

Sara / Nina / Thomas — if you’re OK with the proposed dates but need any earlier checkpoints, ping my office. Looking forward to the sandbox session next week.

Regards,
Michael Ortega
SVP, Product
Atlas Health
